confirmed_root_cause: PostgreSQL deparse/reparse changes the implicit varchar-array-to-text-array coercion of trigger_kind IN (...). The exact receipt correctly detects the different expression tree.
correction: Use an explicitly typed text lhs and ARRAY of text elements. Preserve the same two allowed trigger values and mandatory null rejection; no receipt normalization or restamping.
native_regressions_prepared: Actual PostgreSQL insertion accepts both permitted values and rejects null/empty/unknown/case/whitespace variants using the actual installed constraint in a rollbackable owned temp table.
Actual PostgreSQL deparse/reparse retains the exact constraint text; migration reexecution leaves the existing receipt unchanged.
